Rare 1984 Swiss Platinum Bar – Premex AG Zürich (1/10 oz, Limited Edition)
Offered here is a scarce and highly collectible
1/10 oz fine platinum bar
issued by
Premex AG, Zürich
, in
December 1984
. This piece is part of a strictly limited edition of only
400 individually numbered bars
, making it an uncommon find for both precious metal investors and collectors of vintage bullion. These bars were some of the original collectable versions from
Métaux Précieux SA
Specifications:
Metal: Platinum
Weight: 1/10 troy ounce
Purity: 999.5 fine platinum
Serial Number: 000332
Issue Date: December 1984
Origin: Switzerland
The bar is presented in its
original sealed packaging
with the accompanying
“Bulletin d’essai” (assay certificate)
. The certificate confirms the purity and weight and is signed by
Métaux Précieux SA
, a recognized Swiss precious metals assayer, ensuring authenticity and quality.
About this piece:
This bar represents an early example of
limited-edition platinum bullion from Switzerland
, produced during a time when platinum investment products were far less common than today. Unlike mass-produced modern bars, this issue was released in a small, numbered series, adding to its appeal among collectors of vintage and unusual bullion.
Condition:
Original packaging intact
Light handling/storage wear consistent with age
Bar remains sealed and protected
Why this is special:
Extremely low mintage (only 400 pieces worldwide)
Vintage Swiss issue from the 1980s
Individually numbered with original certificate
Combination of intrinsic metal value and collectible premium potential
A unique opportunity to own a
rare Swiss platinum bar
that stands out from standard bullion offerings.
